metadata.description: An expanded set of diverse, natural-language English prompt templates for generating molecular binders. These prompts avoid rigid prefixes and focus on binding, affinity, and selectivity, suitable for PDB-based structural data.
metadata.notes: English version of the V1.2 templates. Prefixes have been removed for more natural queries. Increased variety in phrasing and sentence structure.
